replies.author: ElfLardLicker
replies.body:
It's pretty awesome! 
But I have spotted some things!

Try to make like and outer layer of a different block on that 4th picture instead of just that stonebrick because it doesn't look smooth and equal to the rest.

And on your buildings add some more block variation, maybe try a new block pallet.

That is probably it from me contact me if you feel that it needs some more feedback. Bai!
